```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(DT)
library(broom)       # tidy model output
library(pROC)        # ROC curves and AUC
library(probably)    # calibration plots (tidymodels-adjacent, well-maintained)
```

## 1. Data prep — build the analytic sample

```{r load_data}
framingham <- read_csv(here("data/raw/framingham.csv"))
```

```{r prep}
# Filter to baseline exam only (PERIOD == 1) so each patient contributes
# one row. CVD is the 10-year binary outcome; predictors are baseline values.
analytic <- framingham %>%
  filter(PERIOD == 1) %>%
  select(
    RANDID,
    # Outcome
    CVD,
    # Predictors
    AGE, SYSBP, TOTCHOL, BMI, GLUCOSE,
    CURSMOKE, DIABETES
  ) %>%
  # Drop rows with any missing value (complete-case analysis)
  drop_na()

datatable(head(analytic, 20), caption = "Analytic sample — first 20 rows")
```

```{r sample_summary}
# Quick sanity check: how many patients, what's the CVD event rate?
analytic %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    n_cvd      = sum(CVD),
    cvd_rate   = round(mean(CVD), 3)
  )
```
```{r}
# Check what PREV* columns exist and their relationship to CVD
framingham %>%
  filter(PERIOD == 1) %>%
  select(starts_with("PREV"), CVD) %>%
  names()

framingham %>%
  filter(PERIOD == 1) %>%
  count(PREVCHD, CVD)   # swap PREVCHD for whatever PREV* column shows up
```

```{r}
# filtering cases where there was disease at baseline, re-checking rates
analytic <- framingham %>%
  filter(PERIOD == 1, PREVCHD == 0) %>%
  select(
    RANDID,
    CVD,
    AGE, SYSBP, TOTCHOL, BMI, GLUCOSE,
    CURSMOKE, DIABETES
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

analytic %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    n_cvd      = sum(CVD),
    cvd_rate   = round(mean(CVD), 3)
  )
```

## 2 - logistic regression predicting CVD

```{r}
cvd_model <- glm(CVD ~ AGE + SYSBP + TOTCHOL + BMI + GLUCOSE + CURSMOKE + DIABETES, family = binomial, data = analytic)

summary(cvd_model)

tidy(cvd_model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))
```

### Examine calibration

```{r}
analytic %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = predict(cvd_model, type = "response"),
    decile = ntile(predicted, 10)
  ) %>%
  group_by(decile) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_predicted = mean(predicted),
    mean_observed  = mean(CVD),
    n              = n()
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_predicted, y = mean_observed)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, colour = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x     = "Mean predicted probability",
    y     = "Observed event rate",
    title = "Calibration plot — CVD logistic model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### ROC and AUC

```{r}
roc_obj <- roc(analytic$CVD, predict(cvd_model, type = "response"))

ggroc(roc_obj, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.3, y = 0.2,
           label = paste0("AUC = ", round(auc(roc_obj), 3))) +
  labs(
    title = "ROC curve — CVD logistic model",
    x     = "Specificity",
    y     = "Sensitivity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
